prompt: Design two refined flat logo candidates for a Chinese web app named Deep Diagnosis AI Agent. Square 1024x1024 transparent PNG. The logo must match a quiet monochrome SaaS chat interface: lots of white space, black/graphite UI, one restrained emerald-teal accent. Make it feel like a small sidebar logo and chatbot avatar, readable at 20-32px. Use a compact circular badge or rounded-square badge with a very simple abstract diagnostic agent glyph: a tiny rounded robot face, a single calm eye/spark, and a subtle scan/insight mark. It should feel premium, calm, minimal, friendly, not medical-clinic, not a large mascot, not a circuit diagram, not an ECG logo, not a brain icon. Flat vector, clean geometry, no 3D, no realistic shading, no detailed antenna forest, no big waveform, no text, no Chinese characters, no letters, no watermark, no checkerboard background.
